purpose: Run the fixed family-relative candidate rule under two preregistered video orders to expose order sensitivity without selecting a winner.
selection_rule: Both fixed permutations of the first two policy-order videos are evaluated; each consumes its first two metadata clock frames, with no order-, label-, score-, or coverage-based selection.
interpretation: This is a bounded fixed-order causal control. Its per-order outcomes are descriptive plumbing evidence, not a selected method, trained memory, an OCD/MOT metric, or Goal A/B/C acceptance.
